# Concept name

Define the concept in one paragraph. State why it exists and what it does not
mean.

## Where it fits

Connect the concept to the main path:

```text
Task -> Loop Practitioner -> Solution Canvas -> Result
```

Name the direct components above and below it. Do not redraw the complete
system unless those relationships would otherwise be unclear.

## Main parts

Use a small table when several exact fields, modes, or responsibilities need
comparison.

## Current behavior

Describe only behavior that exists in the current package. Include a runnable
example or source entry point.

## Boundaries

State what this component does not own. Separate potential future behavior
from current behavior.

## Related pages

Link to one deeper page and one runnable example when available.
